verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes an llms.txt at penpot.app, which agents can be pointed at. It summarises the product and its plugin ecosystem. However, the technical help site (help.penpot.app) returns 404 for llms.txt, so the agent-oriented file appears to cover marketing-level content rather than the full documentation. The hosted instance does serve an auto-generated OpenAPI document that agents could consume as machine-readable API docs. missing for 10: llms.txt on the technical docs site (help.penpot.app), evidence that llms.txt covers in-depth docs rather than product overview, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Penpot vs Figma: Open-source alternative with self-hosting, unlimited files, native design tokens.
